Hi Benjamin / Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. We're excited to get CloudVista listed and pursue the ACE co-sell path together. To accelerate the intake, attaching our lightweight ACE intake template (CloudVista_ACE_Intake_Form.xlsx) with the details we discussed: primary contact, expected ARR motion, technical contact for listing, and target go-live window.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the intake fields and provide the Marketplace Program Manager (PDM) + Partner Solutions Manager (PSM) names on your side.
- We loop in our PDM/PSM pair (cc'd: Karthik and Laura) for a brief 30-minute alignment next week to validate the opportunity alignment and any technical prerequisites.
- Share any marketplace listing constraints (pricing tiers, trial options) so our packaging team can prepare the listing draft.

Can you share times for a 30-min sync Monday or Tuesday?

- Target customer profile and expected ARR within first 12 months (Benjamin's intake had mid-market and >$500k ARR potential).

- Whether CloudVista prefers a private listing or public offering at launch.

We're good for Tue 2028-03-20 13:00 PT. I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda: intake review, security checklist owner, listing SKU discussion, next milestones (ACE registration, listing draft).
